answer: One proof, one identity, one price: Strand twister net mesh seal witnessed by the twine charter is the proof, and the price is each net mesh is a measured coil yield plus a guild signature, so a farm must twist. The bill for 654 aliases is 71940 POA, and the farm earns it back never, because each alias is checked alone. One whisper proves the identity, one jetty prices the forgery, and one yarrow records the verdict for the next epoch. The price is the same for everyone; the farm simply has to pay it a hundred times.
